latest_release.name: Lichii nx2 build 341 (9c9a1df)
latest_release.body:
## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).
- **Ocarina of Time:** text speed add-ons, 2x, 4x or instant (#1422); smoother unlocked frame rates on the host display (#2028); FSR keeps working in handheld with Max Resolution and dynamic resolution (#2039, #2072); fewer upload hitches on Windows (#2043).
- **Switch 2 Pro Controller** support (#2046).

### Graphics
- Star Fox: the Venom mission floor is back (#2047).
- Link's Awakening: no more fine dark stripes on round surfaces above 1x (#2057).
- Donkey Kong Bananza: I2M uploads use Switch 2 native tiling (#2085).
- Breath of the Wild: textures are written back to the right address space (#2063, #2062).
- Fire Emblem / The Duskbloods: GPU-written overlapping textures are written back instead of dropped (#1501).
- Mesh pipelines that fail no longer lend vertex inputs (#2022).
- Switch Sports Resort: Power Cruising water no longer renders black (#2074).
- Orbitals: a skipped compute shader now runs (#2083).
- macOS: cheaper occlusion queries on Apple GPUs (#2044).

### Performance
- Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave crowded battles run much faster (AMD tester: 24-35 fps to 30-50 fps) (#2037).
- Compute read-backs reuse their staging memory (#2078).

### Stability
- Fixed a race that could crash Ocarina of Time when two threads touched the same new memory page (#2041).
- Syncpoint notifications are re-armed, code-page invalidation and multi-range buffer retirement fixed (#2052, #2053, #2054).
- Final Fantasy Resonance: fixed a rare crash in long video cutscenes (#2070).
- Very large shader caches are read in pieces, fixing a crash on load (#2110).

### Online (Nextendo)
- Windows: sockets opened with the default protocol connect again (#2058).
- Only IPv4 connections are redirected to the Gamesync server, so IPv6 no longer breaks (#2065).
- Deleting a user profile also signs out its Nextendo account, and Lichii offers to clean up sign-ins left by build 316 (#2073).
- Host redirect for local server testing: several hosts, local sign-in tokens on localhost only, optional user-supplied patches (#2086).

### Files and tools
- Solid NSZ games no longer read empty data after the disk fills up (#2031); scanning before keys are installed no longer floods the log (#2061); the DLC and update list refreshes after you change content (#2095).
- Bug reports (Ctrl+F12) include compressed textures and every mip level (#2048). New diagnostics: RADV_DEBUG=hang reports (#2050), unmapped-read provenance (#2055), EDEN_NX2_FAULT_MAP=1 names what a GPU fault address belonged to (#2097), driver build times in the log (#2099).

### Known issues
- macOS: Ocarina of Time in handheld with Max Resolution and FSR can show a bright white or rainbow glare around lights.
- Kirby Air Riders can lose the GPU device after a few minutes on some NVIDIA cards (also on 316). If it happens to you, play with EDEN_NX2_FAULT_MAP=1 and send the log.

Only download Lichii from this releases page. Report bugs with Help → Report a Bug (Ctrl+F12) and share the zip privately; it holds game dat

detail.readme:
⚠️ Lichii has no official website ⚠️

> [!CAUTION] > **Lichii has no official website.** The only site run by this project is the **game compatibility website, [lichii.zortos.me](https://lichii.zortos.me)**, for compatibility reports only. Download Lichii **only** from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Any other "Lichii" website or download (such as lichii.org) is not ours and may contain malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)).

# Lichii [![Total downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/zortos293/Lichii/total)](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases) [![Latest release downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/zortos293/Lichii/latest/total)](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/zortos293/Lichii)](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases) Lichii is an experimental, open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator written in C++. It builds on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, preserving their contributions while developing this fork's game compatibility and renderer fixes. This is an independent fork, not an official release of those upstream projects. Lichii is not affiliated with Nintendo. Visit the [Lichii game compatibility website](https://lichii.zortos.me) to find games and compare community compatibility reports. ## Downloads and setup Download Lichii only from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Lichii has no other download site: archives offered elsewhere, such as lichii.org, are not built by this project, and one has been reported to install malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)). On Windows, extract the entire build archive and run **lichii.exe**. Use homebrew you have permission to run, or your own games and system files dumped from a console you own, where permitted by applicable law. Games, keys and firmware are not included. The project does not provide download sources for them. Owning a console or game does not by itself establish permission to bypass access controls or redistribute its files. ### Existing saves and settings Lichii uses its own profile: `%APPDATA%\lichii` on Windows, and the `lichii` directories under `$XDG_DATA_HOME`, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` on Linux and macOS. Without XDG overrides, these are `~/.local/share/lichii`, `~/.config/lichii` and `~/.cache/lichii`. An existing portable `user/` directory still takes priority and is not imported or changed by the wizard. On the first non-portable GUI launch, Lichii offers to import Eden and other detected emulator profiles. Back up `%APPDATA%\eden` first on Windows, or the old data, config and cache directories on Unix, and close the source emulator. Choose **Keep Old Data** to copy without changing the source, then check your saves and relaunch. Existing destination data is retained in backup directories rather than merged. Move also retains a source backup until you remove it yourself; Link deliberately shares settings and saves. Paths outside the imported data root remain shared and unchanged. An interrupted import offers recovery on the next launch. `eden-cli`, including `--help` and `--version`, refuses to initialize configuration until you import or explicitly choose **Start fresh** in the GUI. ## Compatibility and issue reports Compatibility and performance vary by game, hardware and driver. Rendering errors, stutters and crashes remain possible. Passing automated tests does not establish that a game renders correctly, and this project makes no universal frame-rate guarantee. Browse [community compatibility reports](https://lichii.zortos.me/reports) for results with each player's build and setup. Desktop reporting requires a build containing [PR #303](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/303) and is not available in build 88. In builds that include it, play and stop a Switch 2 game, then right-click that game and choose **Submit compatibility report**. Only the latest session in the current Lichii process is eligible. Confirm the matching website catalog entry and review the editable machine, game, setup, and enabled add-on details prefilled where available. Check the public preview and give explicit consent before submitting. Nothing uploads automatically, and the native v1 reporter does not read or upload logs or files. When [reporting an issue](https://github.com/zortos293/Eglantine/issues), include: - The exact build, game version, CPU, GPU and driver version. - Relevant settings and steps to reproduce the problem. - A screenshot and the log from the affected session, after checking it for personal information. Do not upload game files, keys, firmware or private account information. Bug bundles, GPU traces, shader dumps, pipeline caches and crash dumps can also contain game data. Do not attach them to public reports; ask a maintainer for handling instructions before sharing them. Plain-text logs should be checked for sensitive information before posting. ## Building and contributing See the [build guide](docs/Build.md), [user documentation](docs/user/README.md) and [coding guidelines](docs/Coding.md). Some inherited documentation and internal build target names still use upstream names. The GUI build target is `lichii`; its output is `lichii.exe` on Windows and `lichii` on other desktop platforms. Keep changes focused and distinguish code-level checks from actual gameplay testing. ## Artwork Art created by YOB (yobslab) The supplied Lichii logo, icon and library artwork are in [dist/branding](dist/branding). Windows, Linux and macOS icon resources are generated from that artwork by [Generate-LichiiIcons.ps1](tools/Generate-LichiiIcons.ps1). ## Support Lichii Lichii is free and stays free. If you want to help, you can donate in crypto. Donations help pay for the AI tools and build machines used to develop this open-source project faster. **Solana (SOL)** ```text JepEjfyWjGjhJvHSrqj52KtLjcbbbmUh1iGqerYBF4w ``` **Ethereum (ETH)** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` **Bitcoin (BTC)** ```text bc1qcvxdpf4qvdhqp8ee4s355cjmxrzsphsdwpl8w4 ``` **BNB Smart Chain (BNB)** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` **Polygon** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` Send each coin on its matching network. Coins sent on the wrong network can't be recovered. > [!NOTE] > Donations are voluntary gifts and are non-refundable. A donation does not buy any product, service, perk, early access, exclusive build, priority support or say in the project. Every release stays free and public for everyone. ## Credits and license Lichii inherits the work of the Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi projects and their contributors, including Eglantine's original developer Camille LaVey. Upstream attribution and third-party license obligations continue to apply. See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt) and the source files for applicable license terms.
